metadata.title: NSosyal Pusula Turkish Social Media Semantic Evaluation Suite (Hardened)
metadata.description: Hardened project-specific Turkish social-media evaluation suite containing STS pairs (dev/test), 40-item fine-grained clustering corpus, and a 50-document retrieval corpus with hard negatives, lexical overlap traps, same-topic different-event distractors, and negation traps.
linguistic_challenges_tested: Informal spelling, Turkish abbreviations, and slang
Lexical overlap traps (high keyword match, opposite/unrelated semantics)
Same-topic different-event distractors (highway vs city charging)
